decisions.title: LED/800/EU + LED/800/US dimensions
evidence: GROZ_LIGHTING_GL-10_1.pdf physical page 10 (spread), right page: the LED/800 ordering table has columns CAT NR, ORD NR, PLUG TYPE, POWER SOURCE, BOX QTY -- no size column.
The only printed dimension is a callout on the small LED-800 dimension diagram at the bottom right, in three lines: 'Dia.' / '12-1/64"' / '(305 mm)'.
Both variants (EU, US) share the diagram.
decisions.current: dimensions_inch = '12-1/64" (Dia.)', dimensions_mm = '305 mm (Dia.)' -- reworded (word moved, parentheses changed); editorial note published_value '[Not in table]', suggested_correction '12-1/64" (Dia.) / 305 mm (Dia.)'.
decisions.limitation: dimensions_inch / dimensions_mm hold the ordering table's size columns (L x H x D) and cannot say 'diameter', so a diameter in them is either reworded or misleading.
decisions.proposal: Leave dimensions_inch / dimensions_mm empty (the table prints no size). Record the callout verbatim as specifications.diameter = '12-1/64" (305 mm)'. Editorial note: field 'dimensions', published_value 'Dia. 12-1/64" (305 mm)', no suggested_correction, issue text: 'The ordering table has no SIZE column. The only printed dimension is this diameter callout on the LED-800 diagram (physical page 10), recorded verbatim as specifications.diameter.'
alternatives: Keep the current reworded values (not recommended: not verbatim).
Put '12-1/64"' and '(305 mm)' in the size fields verbatim (not recommended: loses that it is a diameter).
decisions.applied: Approved by the project owner on 14 Oct 2026 and applied in extraction rules 2.2.0 (commit 3df9ad3); output_v2 regenerated. Before/after values: review/applied/2026-10-14_rules-2.2.0/all_changes.csv.

decisions.title: ORD 62900 printed twice (Estwing mallets)
evidence: Estwing_Hammer_E-03_Interactive_1.pdf physical page 11, COPPER & HIDE MALLET table: EMLTT/CH-25W 62900 (face dia. 1”/25mm), EMLTT/CH-38W 62901 (1-1/2”/38mm), EMLTT/CH-45W 62900 (1-3/4”/44mm).
Searched all eight catalogue PDFs: 62900 appears only on Estwing page 11 (twice); 62901 only there; 62902 appears in none of them.
The note is attached to EMLTT/CH-45W only; EMLTT/CH-25W carries the same duplicate without a note.
decisions.current: EMLTT/CH-45W note: "Duplicate ORD NR printed in catalogue table: '62900' is printed for both EMLTT/CH-25W (1" dia) and EMLTT/CH-45W (1-3/4" dia). Suspected typographical error in published catalogue; likely intended as 62902 following sequence, pending human review."
decisions.limitation: The catalogue does not show which variant the number belongs to; '62902' is an unsupported guess.
decisions.proposal: Replace the note text on EMLTT/CH-45W, and add the same note to EMLTT/CH-25W, with: "Duplicate ORD NR printed in catalogue table: '62900' is printed for both EMLTT/CH-25W (face dia. 1”/25mm) and EMLTT/CH-45W (face dia. 1-3/4”/44mm) in the Copper & Hide Mallet table (physical page 11); EMLTT/CH-38W between them is printed as 62901. The catalogue does not show which variant this order number belongs to; confirmation from GROZ is needed." published_value '62900', suggested_correction empty, status pending_review. Both ORD fields stay '62900' as printed.
alternatives: Keep the note on EMLTT/CH-45W only, with the corrected wording.

decisions.title: Precision catalogue index vs product pages
evidence: Index (physical pages 82-83) lists 634 ORD numbers with page references.
3 indexed numbers appear on no product page: 01217 (index page 12 = physical 14), 35044 and 35045 (index page 75 = physical 77; the page prints only SCV/SP/100 35040).
29 products printed on product pages are absent from the index: 01227 (DG/6/IN), 14 workshop-grade DSW items 08520-08533, 14 COB tool bits 12201-12207 and 12221-12227.
Physical page 14 (printed 12) prints DG/6/IN 01227, which is not indexed, while the index lists 01217 for that page: possibly one product with a typo on one side; which number is right is unknown.
Index page references often cite a product family's first page (e.g. TB tool bits printed on page 55 are indexed to 54); that convention is not treated as a discrepancy.
decisions.current: All 29 printed products are records (printed evidence); the 3 index-only numbers are not records. Listed in output_v2/reports/index_discrepancies.csv and change report section 16.
decisions.limitation: Source discrepancies, not extraction defects; they cannot be resolved from the files.
decisions.proposal: Keep the data as is and keep the list for review. Optionally ask GROZ about 01217 vs 01227 and about 35044/35045.
decisions.applied: Reviewed 14 Oct 2026: no data change (source discrepancies kept on the list).

decisions.title: Product headings (sub_title) taken from the page banner, not from the product's own title (new observation, 14 Oct 2026)
evidence: Each catalogue prints its product titles in one dedicated type: Mont-Heavy 16 pt (GROZ Tool Storage, Lighting, Precision; Lighting adds a Mont-Book 14 pt second line) and Futura-Bold 12 pt (Estwing). Every text set in these types is a product title, except 'NOTES' in Estwing.

sub_title is read from a fixed rectangle at the top of the page (y 40-140), so it mixes the title with description lines (e.g. 'Tool Bits & Cut Off Blades Square Toolbits and Cut Off Blades are') and gives products in lower sections of a page, or on a facing page, another product's heading.

Checked against the rendered pages: Estwing physical page 4 prints CLUB HAMMERS above ECH-212X/412X/416X (sub_title 'BS 876 SLEDGE HAMMERS'); page 5 prints TIRE BEAD BREAK HAMMERS above ETH-520X/1032X (sub_title 'SLEDGE HAMMERS - COPPER') and MACHINIST HAMMERS above the four EMH products (sub_title 'SLEDGE HAMMERS - BRASS'); page 16 prints SAN ANGELO BAR above ESAB-72 and POST HOLE DIGGING BAR above EPHD-69 (sub_titles 'ROLL HEAD PRY BARS' / 'CAT/ALIGNING BARS').

Precision physical page 45 prints two sections, 'Adjustable Angle Block 0-60°' and 'Vee Blocks Cast Iron'; the nine VB/C products get the first. Page 7 prints no title and continues 'Engineer's Precision Squares' from the facing page 6; its ten SS/A products have sub_title 'ACC.' (from the 'ACC. BS 939' badge).
Lighting LED/685T: sub_title 'Floodlight complete with tripod', but its own table row prints 'Sitelamp complete with tripod' on the 'Cordless Sitelamp 3 Head Design' spread (physical page 9).

Full list with the rule and page used for every product: review/display_titles.csv (generated by build_site_data.py). 111 products have a sub_title that names a different product or section; 553 have the right title plus extra text; 175 have no sub_title; 11 lack the subtitle line (e.g. 'Floodlight' for 'Floodlight 12W'); 91 match.
decisions.current: output_v2 sub_title unchanged. The local website shows the printed title read from the PDF (backend/site/titles.py, presentation layer only), names the rule and page it came from, and keeps the extracted heading visible in the product details.
decisions.limitation: Titles are product-family names; variants are still told apart by CAT NR, ORD NR and specifications. 'Facing page' and 'only title on the spread/page' attributions rely on the catalogue layout and are labelled as such.
decisions.proposal: In the next extraction-rules version, read the product heading with the same rules as backend/site/titles.py (nearest title above the product's ordering table in the same column or half spread; else the only title on the page or spread; else the facing page's only title), keep the old value traceable in the change report, and regenerate output_v2 only after approval (together with decision E if approved).
alternatives: Keep sub_title as is and rely on the website's display title (not recommended: exports and reports would keep the wrong headings).
decisions.applied: Approved by the project owner on 14 Oct 2026 and applied in extraction rules 2.2.0 (commit 3df9ad3); output_v2 regenerated. Before/after values: review/applied/2026-10-14_rules-2.2.0/all_changes.csv.

decisions.title: Product pictures linked by page evidence (extraction rules 2.3.0, new observation, 14 Oct 2026)
decisions.status: proposed; awaiting the project owner's approval
evidence: In output_v2 (rules 2.2.0) 211 products have only an unresolved picture candidate and 50 have none; 680 of 941 show a picture.

Codes printed in an ordering table were read as picture labels: the first rows of a table printed under a picture got 'product code printed beside the image' (e.g. Estwing EMH-0313X, physical page 5) and the other rows of the same table did not.

Picture labels were matched by prefix and could reach the wrong picture: 'MS/7' matched the label 'MS/7/AL'; a code printed between two pictures labelled both; on spreads labels crossed the fold (tools_storage p26).
Tall, thin product photos were discarded as icons (narrower than 40 pt): the tweezers on Precision physical pages 58-59 and the scribers on page 40, each printed with its own code under it.

The pin vices (Precision p60) and edge finders (p33) are cut-out pictures set diagonally whose boxes overlap; each code is printed inside two boxes. The pictures' transparency masks show which tool the code is printed under (checked by overlaying the masks on the rendered page).

The layout rule ('largest picture in the page region') gave products pictures labelled for another product (the aluminium scriber MS/380A for ten steel body scribers, p40; the IP65 micrometer MMED/1/65 for MMED/1 and MMED/2, p19), and chapter-divider or lifestyle photos printed beside a section (Lighting p5, tools_storage p13, p15, p27).

Every page whose picture changes was checked against the rendered page with the old and new pictures marked (overlay sheets, 53 pages; the remaining pages only lose a borrowed picture or change evidence type on the same picture). Regression tests: tests/test_image_evidence.py.
decisions.current: output_v2 unchanged (rules 2.2.0). The rules are committed (2033b7e) and previewed: review/preview_batch_1.md/.csv and review/preview_batch_2.md/.csv.
decisions.limitation: A section or caption picture is a family picture (product_family): it shows the product family printed in that section, not necessarily the exact variant. Products whose page pictures several variants but not their own stay unconfirmed. Family pictures are not verified until a reviewer checks them in the verification tool.
decisions.proposal: Apply rules 2.3.0 to output_v2 (recovery), keeping all 941 records. Preview: 941 matched, 0 added, 0 missing; 374 picture changes (32 in batch_1, 342 in batch_2): 225 products gain a picture, 100 get a better-evidenced picture, 26 no longer show a picture labelled for another product. Pictures shown 680 -> 879; direct product pictures 49 -> 83; unresolved 211 -> 59; no picture 50 -> 3. One heading changes: EKIT-2F 'AXE KIT: AXE WITH SHARPENER' -> 'POWER DUO - 2PC KIT' (the title printed over its own column). The website title reader would pass the CAT NR in the same commit (one display title, EKIT-2F).
decisions.alternatives: Keep 2.2.0 pictures (210 more products without a confirmed picture), or apply only the label fixes (direct pictures) without the caption/section rules.
